check = "I(ATEST0)", checkLines = ["I(ATEST0)"], description = "IBP 0.5UA HR", expectValue = 0.5 uA, registerFields = [{EN_ATEST0,1},{ATEST0_MUX,4}], code2Raw = "en_tm[]\nfield[(EN_ATEST0,1),(ATEST0_MUX,4)]\nvset[vdm,1,100e-6,0]" with code2[2] = {kind:'vset', pin:'vdm', value:'1'} — the governing TM103 row enables the ATEST0 output with select 4 and drives/measures it on the physical pin vdm.

ATEST0 select code 4 is '4 \t 100 \t D2A_HSKP_ATEST0 \t 3 \t IBP_HR_0.5UA' — select 4 chooses the internal IBP_HR 0.5 uA current branch, which matches the TM103 ExpectValue 0.5 uA and the name LP_HR_0P5U / description 'IBP 0.5UA HR'. This proves ATEST0 is a logical test-output function whose payload is mux-selected, i.e. exactly the case the stop rule says must be resolved to a physical pin rather than treated as a pin name.

Every project function whose check is the ATEST0 current observation pairs it with pin vdm: TM103 (ATEST0_MUX 4), TM104 (5), TM133 (8), TM134 (9) all carry vset[vdm,...]; no function observes I(ATEST0) on any other pin, and no function observes ATEST0 without driving vdm. TM133/TM134 additionally set the amux rail, but the signed decision for THIS item declares no AMUX supply, sweep or monitor.

The generated TM103 code writes I2CWriteSameData(DEV_ADDR, 0x5E, 0x04) with the commented field[(EN_ATEST0,1),(ATEST0_MUX,4)] and then ramps the VDM source line ('NVT_STIM.en_vsrc_vdm = 1; NVT_STIM.vsrcVDM.ramp_vsrc_val(1, 100e-6)'), i.e. the ATEST0 observation is physically performed on the VDM source line.

The binding resolved entry states the monitor as 'I(ATEST0) IBP_HR 0.5 uA current, forced/measured on the VDM pin' with monitorDutPin 'VDM' — the only physical DUT pin the decision declares for this monitor. The project evidence above independently corroborates that binding.

unionMembersNotProvenAsRoute.observation: Both tokens appear ON inside the trial artifact's relay union records (team/artifacts/tm103-ptc/schematic/SCH-Connect-Map.json relays[] entries at numbers 86 and 130) and their dutPins union includes VDM. The token 'K86' and the token 'K130' have ZERO occurrences in project/DALI/SCH-Connect-Map.txt (verified by search: 0 hits each), so the project's own path enumeration never names them on any route.
unionMembersNotProvenAsRoute.whatTheProjectEvidenceActuallyShows: project/DALI/path_proofs.json.txt (relay contact records) shows K86_KELVIN0_F_S1 bridging NetK86_KELVIN0_F_S1_2 (fed by K87_KELVIN0 from FPVIe0_FH_BUS_S1) to NetK86_KELVIN0_F_S1_1 (feeding K88_KELVIN0 into FPVIe0_SH_BUS_S1), and symmetrically K130_KELVIN1_F_S1 bridging K131_KELVIN1 (FPVIe1_FH_BUS_S1) to K132_KELVIN1 (FPVIe1_SH_BUS_S1). They are therefore elements of the FPVIe force/sense bus Kelvin bridge, i.e. of the REJECTED FPVIe0/FPVIe1 bus alternatives, not of the selected S3_5 -> K8(NC) -> VBAT and S5_7 -> K59(NC) -> VDM paths.
unionMembersNotProvenAsRoute.handling: NOT included in setOnClosure and NOT claimed as route elements of either selected path. They are reported here rather than silently dropped or substituted. The exclusion is safe for this item because K7_BUSH_VBAT stays un-actuated (every bus->VBAT path requires K7) and K58_BUSH_VDM stays un-actuated (every bus->VDM path requires K58), so an ON K86/K130 tie on the FPVIe bus cannot reach either endpoint. Their required frame state is nevertheless recorded as an open item (OI-TM103-STR-04) for the review/method stage, because no project path line proves them and this contract therefore does not assert them.
unionMembersNotProvenAsRoute.notSubstituted: No similarly named relay (K87/K88/K89, K131/K132/K133) was used to stand in for them.

setOnClosure.rationale: both selected paths conduct through un-actuated series elements (K8_PD3 for VBAT, K59_SDA for VDM) and require zero energized route relays; the only mandatory energized relay is the VBAT reservoir-cap gate K13_VBAT_Cap. SetOn is exclusive, so every relay not listed here is OFF - which is exactly what the two selected paths and both isolation requirements demand.
setOnClosure.scheduleOwnership: when in the sequence K13 is closed is a power-sequencing decision and belongs to test-method-expert, not to this contract
